svg.title: Serbia after the Balkan Wars
svg.desc: Situation map covering 17.6°E to 24.4°E, 40.2°N to 45.6°N. The kingdom nearly doubled in a year, all of it to the south. Change in ground held by Kingdom of Serbia, 1912 to August 1913: held throughout 57%, taken 43%. Both extents are OpenHistoricalMap relations, taken by one script from one source under one tagging scheme, so the difference between them is the change it records and not a change of method. Crowd-sourced: the border precision varies along its length. Present-day frontiers are not drawn: on a plate of a past year they would be a different claim. OpenHistoricalMap relations 2692716 and 2746681 (CC0); Natural Earth basemap. Before October 1912 and after 10 August 1913. 2 mapped features can be reached with the Tab key, each one naming what it is.

g.aria-label: Note 3. The Sandžak of Novi Pazar, split with Montenegro: the two Serb kingdoms now share a border.
